doc.title: Howard Alden interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 11, 1997

title: Plans for the future
summary: He wants to keep improving and do more solo guitar, keeping overhead low.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans
story.community_name: What's next: upcoming tours, records and plans

blocks.x: What’s in the future for you? If I was to sit with you a few years from now, and we could talk about, that you’ve been doing what?

Well hopefully playing better, and I don’t know. Quite frankly I’m just enjoying what I’m doing right now. I just want to do more of it. And like I said, get better. Actually I’m working on doing some more solo guitar playing. I’m always enjoyed doing a little bit over the years and stuff. I’m trying to do more of that both on the electric and acoustic seven string.
Try to keep the overhead low.
Keep the music swinging and the overhead low.
